'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Second Battle of Lyman]]
*****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] recapture [[Lyman, Ukraine|Lyman]] after weeks of fighting for the city and one day after the [[Annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine|annexation]] of the [[Donetsk People's Republic]] to [[Russia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/oct/01/russia-ukraine-war-ukrainians-advance-on-lyman-after-putins-annexations-live (''The Guardian'')]
*****The [[Ministry of Defence of Russia]] says that it has withdrawn troops from the town of Lyman due to "a threat of encirclement". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63102220 (BBC News)]
*****After the defeat in Lyman, the [[head of Chechnya]], [[Ramzan Kadyrov]], calls on the Russian government to introduce [[Martial law in Russia|martial law]] and use [[Tactical nuclear weapon|low-yield nuclear weapons]] in [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.mk.ru/politics/2022/10/01/kadyrov-posle-limana-prizval-ispolzovat-yadernoe-oruzhie.html (Moskovskij Komsomolets)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/01/europe/ukraine-russia-lyman-donetsk-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-troops-left-lyman-avoid-encirclement-2022-10-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2022/10/1/ukraine-blog-3 (Al Jazeera)]
***[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
*****A civilian convoy of seven cars attacked by Russian forces is discovered in [[Kupiansk Raion]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]] with 24 people being killed, including a [[Pregnancy|pregnant]] woman and 13 children, according to local governor [[Oleh Synyehubov]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2022/10/1/7369956/ (Ukrainska Pravda)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**An 18-year-old man is killed by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[East Jerusalem]], making him the 100th [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] killed in the [[West Bank]] this year. It is the deadliest toll of Palestinians killed there by Israeli raids since 2015. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63073541 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The death toll from [[Hurricane Ian]] increases to 84. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/ian-hurricane-death-toll-grows-florida-south-carolina-virginia-rcna50312 (NBC News)]
*Three people are killed and two others are injured after a helicopter crashes in [[Frontera, Tabasco|Frontera]], [[Tabasco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-caribbean-accidents-helicopter-crashes-965bc79e05cab30a32194d8506f35db6 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[Canada]] formally ends all COVID-19 border measures, including vaccination requirements, pre-arrival testing, and quarantine, allowing all travellers to enter the country unrestricted without needing to submit public health information through the ArriveCAN government mobile app. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9155762/covid-19-border-rules-arrivecan-update/ (Global News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuela]] releases seven Americans from its custody, including five [[Citgo]] executives, in exchange for two nephews of [[First Lady of Venezuela|Venezuelan First Lady]] [[Cilia Flores]] who had previously been convicted of drug smuggling in the [[United States]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/10/01/venezuela-jailed-americans-u-s-2-prisoners-00059894 (Politico)]
*Togolese [[Gilbert Houngbo]] becomes the new Director-General of the [[International Labour Organization]], succeeding British [[Guy Ryder]]. [https://northafricapost.com/61333-gilbert-houngbo-officially-replaces-guy-ryder-at-international-labor-organization.html (North Africa Report)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Kanjuruhan Stadium disaster]]
**At least 125 people are killed in a human crush following the dispersal of [[riot]]ors by tear gas. The riot occurred between supporters of [[Indonesia]]n [[Association football|football teams]] [[Arema F.C.]] and [[Persebaya Surabaya]] at the [[Kanjuruhan Stadium]] in [[Malang Regency]], [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/2/127-killed-after-stampede-at-indonesia-football-match (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kurdish separatism in Iran]], [[Iran–Iraq relations]]
**Protests break out in [[Baghdad]] against Iranian involvement in the country following a series of missile and artillery strikes by the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] that killed dozens of civilians in [[Iraqi Kurdistan]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202210015697 (Iran International)]

**Iranians around the world hold rallies in more than 160 cities in solidarity with protesters. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/amp/2022/09/29/iran-protesters-gather-outside-european-parliament-ask-eu-to-do-more (Euronews)]
*[[2022 Latvian parliamentary election]]
